name: MN-07
label: Safe R

key_factors: No polls or expert ratings; markets price 97% Republican
model.rationale: The R+18 district, Fischbach's incumbency, and her roughly four-to-one fundraising advantage over Osberg leave little evidence of a competitive race, and prediction markets price her near certain to win. With no polls or expert ratings suggesting otherwise, the forecast stays near the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing Osberg within single digits, or major outside spending into the district, would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
MN-07 is a heavily Republican western Minnesota district where incumbent Michelle Fischbach is seeking another term. She has raised about $1.3 million and holds roughly $920,000 on hand, while Democratic challenger Erik Osberg has raised about $330,000 with $114,000 available. No outside spending of consequence has appeared on either side.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on the district's strong Republican lean, Fischbach's incumbency advantage, and the lopsided financial picture. Prediction markets give Republicans about a 97% chance of holding the seat, consistent with a comfortable double-digit expected margin for Fischbach.
